quote.text: My flight changed and I don't know what else is affected

promise.text: Flight schedule changed? What else in your trip to check

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "flight"

lines.text: Decide about the flight first, then check the transfer, hotel check-in and dinner that were booked around it, one at a time.

head.text: Write the old time and the new time, side by side, with the booking reference and the name it's under.
List everything you booked that comes after the flight in time: the transfer, the check-in, the first night's dinner, a pickup, a rental car.
For each item, write the one thing it was built on.

body.text: A check-in is usually built on a transfer, and a transfer on a flight.

head.text: Go down the list in order.

body.text: For each item ask whether it still works with the new time.
Often two of five are fine.

head.text: Fix one item, write the new fact beside it, and only then move to the next.

line.text: Record the change and it walks down everything you said was booked around it, one booking at a time, editing nothing for you.

title.text: Flight schedule changed? What else in your trip to check
